title: Stress that changes the word
what: the same stress for noun and verb pairs ('a REcord' and 'to reCORD', 'an INcrease' and 'to inCREASE')
summary: This error persists because many noun-verb pairs are spelled identically, making the subtle shift in stress easily overlooked. Misplacing stress can obscure meaning or make speech sound less natural, despite advanced fluency.
listenFor: Notice if the primary stress in two-syllable words shifts when the word functions as a noun versus a verb.
